items.q: at that same time Ira Sullivan was selling clothes at some men's shop

ctx.x: Yeah, and it got very -- well, you know how this business can get, very horrible. Til you have no work, or distressing jobs. And if you can't do anything, if you can't do anything, then you're in trouble.
That's -- at that same time Ira Sullivan was selling clothes at some men's shop in I think Rothschilds in Park Forest.
